race.comment: VELVET MORNING (12) makes her debut with some strong jump-out form from last month behind her, and the way that the Ben Brisbourne stable is going at the moment, she should be very hard to hold out. PRESTIGE HELLBENT (4) has made good progress at the jump-outs, and he makes his debut with the blinkers on for the first time. Include in all top 4 combos. NEXT SATURDAY (3) is a stablemate of the fourth pick, and he has shown enough at the jump-outs to suggest he can pick up a win at short notice. Use the market as a guide here. BORDEAX (16) makes the field off the ballot, and will start from a good draw fresh up under Ben Allen. He has his first run as a gelding, and will be worth following in the markets. TURBO BABAA (13) won a trial before showing speed and fading late fresh up at Sale 17 days ago. Keep her very safe.
